subject: Offer approval: SDE2 standard package — Alex Romero
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priyash@talentfind.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Romero <alex.romero@cobalt.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer packet for Alex Romero — SDE2 (Horizon Health)

Hi Grace,

Hope you’re well — quick one. Horizon Health (hiring manager: Miguel Santos) has selected Alex Romero for an SDE2 role following final loop last week. They asked us to confirm an offer ASAP so they can close the candidate this week. Attached is a draft offer summary and our comp-band reference for Q3. Highlights: 

- Base: $155,000
- Bonus (annual): 10% target
- Equity: 0.6% standard RSU grant (4-year schedule, 25%/quarter vesting in year 1 then annual thereafter per their standard)
- Start date: target 2027-01-11

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood sign off on the band and the RSU structure above (there's some back-and-forth expected about vesting cadence)?
2) Any constraints on start-date-related relocation window (candidate needs a Feb home closing contingency).

I’ve added the offer spreadsheet as an attachment (redwood_offer_summary_alex_romero.xlsx). Candidate is eager and has one competing onsite that might push an acceptance deadline to 10/26.

Thanks — Priya

Attachments: redwood_offer_summary_alex_romero.xlsx, comp_band_reference_q3_2026.pdf
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Priya Shah <priyash@talentfind.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@cobalt.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Alex Romero — SDE2 (Horizon Health)

Thanks Priya — looping in Karthik and Marissa for comp and headcount sign-off. Laura, FYI in case you want to weigh in on relocation timing.

Quick notes from my side after a skim of the sheet: 
- Base/bonus are within our SDE2 standard band for West Coast hires; comp_band_reference_q3_2026.pdf confirms midpoint is $150–160k.
- Equity looks slightly above the usual 0.5% for SDE2; 0.6% is reasonable given seniority of candidate and market, but I want finance/comp to confirm impact on budget.
- Vesting cadence: candidate prefers standard quarterly first-year cliff (they asked for 25% at 6 months). We typically do 25% at 12 months then annual thereafter — this is the main negotiation point.

Action items for internal: 
- Karthik: can you confirm headcount and budget impact if we push to 0.6% RSU vs 0.5%? If not approved, what's the max we can offer without exception?
- Marissa: please confirm comp band alignment and whether approving 0.6% will require extra authorizations (or is within delegated authority).
- Laura: any constraints on offering a flexible start/relocation window (candidate asked for Feb closing)?

If we can get signoff today, I’ll ask Priya to send a final DocuSign packet and target an acceptance by 10/26.

Thanks — Grace

Signature: Grace O'Connor
Sr. Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Alex Romero — SDE2 (Horizon Health)

Grace / Marissa — saw the details. Quick answers:

- Headcount: Approved against REQ-1423 (open SDE2 in Horizon Health team). No headcount reallocation needed.
- Budget impact: moving from 0.5% to 0.6% RSU increases FY27 comp burn by ~2.8k (NPV across grant window). That is within our team budget tolerance but it crosses the 0.5% threshold that normally requires a manager-level approval (I can sign if Marissa confirms delegation).
- Vesting cadence: We should hold to standard Redwood schedule (25% at 12 months, then annual thereafter). Candidate preference for an accelerated first-year cliff (25% at 6 months) is non-standard and I recommend declining; instead offer a 4-year schedule with a 6-month start-date flexibility to help relocation.

Marissa — can you confirm the sign-off authority? If you approve, Karthik will finalize the written exception.

Karthik
VP, Talent Operations
